claim_text: GZMK+ NK -> ENTPD1+ ISG-high effector state

audit.primary_source_citation: Serger CC, Rebuffet L, Sandholzer MT, Rackwitz W, Fusi I, Herzig P, ... Schaeuble K, Vivier E, Romagnani A, Zippelius A. "Cytotoxic CD39+ tumor-associated NK cells respond to NKG2A blockade in lung cancer." Sci Immunol. 2026 Jun 5;11(120):eaeb6645. doi:10.1126/sciimmunol.aeb6645. PMID 42247486. CITATION VERIFIED TO EXIST — the hint's "Serger 2026 snRNA+snATAC trajectory" is real (first author Clara C. Serger, Basel; senior author Alfred Zippelius; Eric Vivier co-author). Author manuscript = bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.08.26.672316: v1 (2025-08-30, "Integrated single cell analysis identifies CD39+ tumor-associated NK cells with cytotoxic potential in lung cancer") and v2 (2026-05-05, same title/author list as the published article). It is a PRIMARY paper, not a review.

audit.species: Human (Homo sapiens). Discovery arm: treatment-naive NSCLC patients (LUAD and LUSC), University Hospital Basel / Kantonsspital Baselland. Supporting in vitro arm: healthy-donor peripheral blood NK cells. No animal work in this paper.
audit.what_was_measured: In humans (11 treatment-naive NSCLC patients; 7 LUAD, 4 LUSC), at a SINGLE cross-sectional timepoint (surgical resection; no repeat sampling of any patient), FACS-sorted live CD45+CD19-CD14-CD56+ cells from cryopreserved tumour digests were lysed to nuclei and profiled by paired 10x Multiome snRNA-seq + snATAC-seq; after QC and WNN integration 29,890 high-quality NK nuclei were retained (T/B/myeloid/Treg removed computationally; T cells removed by a UCell CD3D/CD3G score < 0.05 threshold). The readout that generates the claimed transition is a COMPUTATIONAL ORDERING of the NK3 subcompartment pooled across all 11 donors: (i) MultiVelo v0.1.5 RNA+ATAC velocity streamlines on top-1000 variable genes; (ii) destiny v3.4.0 diffusion-map pseudotime, run separately on RNA and on ATAC gene-activity scores, with "the main root selected from the NK3_GZMK cluster"; (iii) Monocle3 v1.3.1 pseudotime (v1 methods) with learn_graph ncenter=100 and "the starting point defined as the terminal branch within the NK3_GZMK population"; (iv) top-100 Moran's I pseudotime-correlated genes (CD44/GZMK early -> IFIT3/IFI44/ISG15/GZMB mid -> KLRC1/LAYN/ENTPD1/ITGAE/KLRC2/GZMA late) and SCENIC+ eRegulon activity (TCF7/BACH2 -> STAT1/NFKB/FOS/JUNB/RUNX2) plotted along that same pseudotime. Protein-level work measured STATE, not transition: flow cytometry of CD45+CD14-CD19-CD3-CD56+ cells from an independent cohort (tumour n=15, adjacent lung n=13, blood n=12; marker panel n=14; GZMA in CD39+ vs CD39- n=11); 5/24 h restimulation with IL-12/IL-15/IL-18 or irradiated K562 (n=8; CD39+/- comparison n=7); 48 h anti-NKG2A (monalizumab biosimilar) vs isotype in patient-derived tumour fragments (n=7); 10x Xenium spatial transcriptomics on ONE LUAD patient (LuT-722). In the published version only, an in vitro platform: healthy-donor blood NK + IL-15 + TGF-beta +/- irradiated A549 (10:1) for 6 days, flow + bulk RNA-seq at day 6, then sorted CD103+CD49a+CD39+/- cells in 24 h A549-b2m-ko killing assays (n=6-7 donors). NO cell, clone, donor or nucleus was tracked over time; no GZMK+ NK cell was sorted and re-assayed; no barcoding, no mtDNA clonal tracing, no transfer, no genetic fate map.
audit.n_unit: patients (treatment-naive NSCLC donors) contributing nuclei to the multiome dataset on which the ENTIRE trajectory claim rests; the NK3 cells were POOLED across these 11 donors and no per-donor replication of the trajectory (or leave-one-donor-out) is reported. Validation cohorts, all in donors/patients: flow tumour n=15, adjacent lung n=13, blood n=12, marker panel n=14, CD39+/- GZMA n=11, restimulation n=8 (CD39 split n=7), PDTF anti-NKG2A n=7, in vitro taNK platform/killing n=6-7 healthy donors, Xenium n=1 patient. Public comparison data: 50 non-tumour lung donors (Sikkema/Bischoff). Cell counts (57,854 total; 29,890 NK nuclei) are NOT n.
audit.controls: (1) Non-tumour comparison tissue: adjacent non-tumour lung and peripheral blood by flow (n=13, n=12), plus integration with two public non-tumour lung NK datasets (Sikkema, Bischoff; 20,198 NK cells from 50 donors) — establishes that the ENTPD1+/CD103+/CD49a+ state is tumour-restricted. (2) Internal cell-intrinsic comparator: CD103-CD49a- (and CD39-) NK from the same digest, with paired non-parametric statistics. (3) Isotype IgG4 control for anti-NKG2A in PDTFs, plus target-engagement check (surface NKG2A loss). (4) Unstimulated and tumour-cell-only baselines in restimulation/killing assays. (5) QC/artefact controls: patient-specific stress cluster (Cluster 5, one patient) excluded; histone/ribosomal gene blacklist; mitochondrial % regressed; CCA/LSI donor batch correction; ATAC diffusion component 1 discarded as sequencing-quality-driven; CD3D used in Xenium to exclude T cells. MISSING CONTROLS RELEVANT TO THE LINEAGE CLAIM: no alternative-root / root-free trajectory analysis (root was analyst-placed in NK3_GZMK in both Monocle3 and destiny); no per-donor or held-out-donor reproduction of the trajectory; NK1/NK2/ILC1 compartments were EXCLUDED before trajectory inference, so no non-NK3 progenitor could have been recovered by construction; no protein-level (CITE-seq/hashing) confirmation that the transcriptomically CD3-low NK3_ENTPD1 nuclei are truly CD3-negative NK rather than NK-like/CD3-dim T cells (the cluster expresses CD3E, IL32, CTLA4, CXCL13, LAYN); no negative-control trajectory on a population known not to interconvert.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: NK3_GZMK and NK3_ENTPD1 are two independently seeded/maintained states that sit adjacent in expression space, not a precursor and its product. Concretely: (a) GZMK marks CD56bright NK — Bratke 2005 (PMID 16106370) shows ALL CD56bright NK are GZMK+ while GZMB is confined to CD56dim, and the paper itself annotates NK3_GZMK by CD56bright genes (CD44, GZMK, CXCR4) — so NK3_GZMK is plausibly recently-immigrated circulating CD56bright NK, while NK3_ENTPD1 is a locally imprinted (TGF-beta/IL-15) tissue-resident state, or a pre-existing adaptive-like CD49a+CD103+NKG2C+ lung trNK population that expands in tumour (Brownlie 2021, PMID 33836578 — these cells exist in HEALTHY human lung and blood). Under that model the "trajectory" recovers a residency/maturation gradient plus donor-to-donor mixing, not a conversion. (b) The ordering's DIRECTION is not data-derived: the Monocle3 start point was "defined as the terminal branch within the NK3_GZMK population" and the destiny root "selected from the NK3_GZMK cluster"; MultiVelo streamlines on single-NUCLEUS data (intron-dominated, spliced/unspliced ratios distorted relative to whole-cell scRNA-seq) supplied the prior for that choice. Root choice, not biology, fixes GZMK as "early". (c) The ISG-high midpoint (IFIT3, IFI44, ISG15) is more parsimoniously an acute, reversible interferon-response state layered on any NK cell than a differentiation waypoint — ISG-high clusters recur across cell types and conditions and can be induced or lost within hours. (d) ENTPD1/CD39 is an activation-inducible ectoenzyme, not a lineage mark: the authors themselves induce it on healthy-donor blood NK within 6 days with IL-15+TGF-beta, so the "endpoint" may be a reversible activation state occupied and vacated by many cells. (e) Technical: sorting was CD45+CD19-CD14-CD56+CD3+ (NK plus T) with T cells removed only by a transcriptomic CD3D/CD3G threshold; NK3_ENTPD1 carries a CD8-Trm/tumour-reactive program (CD3E, IL32, CTLA4, CXCL13, LAYN, ITGAE, ENTPD1), so residual CD3-dim T cells, T-NK doublet nuclei or ambient signal would create exactly the observed "endpoint" and exactly the observed apparent gradient from a bona fide NK cluster toward it. The Xenium CD3D check was one patient and does not address doublets in the multiome.
audit.counter_evidence: FOUND, including from the paper itself. (1) SELF-CONTRADICTING, same paper, published version: a new "Cross-modality analysis suggests distinct epigenetic origins" section concludes that the two taNK branches "represent distinct lineages that converge transcriptionally, while retaining their ancestral chromatin marks" (NK3_CRTAM/CAMK4 -> ATAC cluster a2; NK3_ENTPD1 -> ATAC cluster a6) — i.e. the authors endorse independent origins for the sister branch of the very bifurcation whose root is GZMK. (2) SELF-HEDGING, same paper: for the only time-resolved experiment (48 h PDTF anti-NKG2A) they write "Anti-NKG2A therapy either expands existing CD39+GZMA+ and CD39+GZMB+ populations or promotes their induction from CD39- precursors", and in the discussion "their exact origin remains unresolved... both circulating and pre-existing tissue-resident NK cells may contribute", and CRTAM+ cells "may represent a tissue-resident, adaptive-like subset that expands upon tumour progression... this interpretation remains speculative". (3) Brownlie et al., PNAS 2021, PMID 33836578 (archived): adaptive-like CD49a+CD103+NKG2C+ CD56bright trNK are already present in healthy human lung and in blood with donor-variable expansions — a pre-existing, selectable subset, i.e. the canonical alternative, and re-entry from tissue to blood is proposed. (4) Mogilenko et al., Immunity 2021, PMID 33271118 (archived): in the better-characterised CD8 compartment, GZMK+ cells (Taa) are a highly CLONAL, epigenetically distinct population separate from Tem, not an obligatory transitional precursor — cautionary counter-analogy for reading "GZMK+" as "early". (5) Tang et al., Cell 2023, PMID 37607536 (archived; 716 patients, 24 cancer types): the tumour-enriched NK population identified pan-cancer shows IMPAIRED anti-tumour function and associates with UNFAVOURABLE prognosis and immunotherapy RESISTANCE — the opposite functional valence to Serger's CD39+ "effector" endpoint, undermining the "culminates in an effector state" framing. (6) Horowitz et al., Sci Transl Med 2026, PMID 42090477 (archived): CD39+CD49a+CD103+ cytotoxic trNK can be differentiated ex vivo from PERIPHERAL NK and control mouse tumours — supports inducibility of the endpoint phenotype but from a different starting population and via TGF-beta, not via a GZMK+ intratumoural precursor or an ISG-driven route, so it does not corroborate this specific transition. (7) NEGATIVE SEARCH RESULT (searched, not found): no clonal or mitochondrial-variant lineage-tracing study of human intratumoural NK subsets was located (query "mitochondrial variant lineage tracing natural killer cells human" returned 0 PubMed hits); no independent dataset reproducing a GZMK+ -> ENTPD1+ NK ordering was found.
audit.downstream_dependency: Named, concrete: (1) The paper's own ex vivo "in vitro taNK cell platform" for adoptive cell therapy — healthy-donor blood NK + IL-15 + TGF-beta + irradiated A549 for 6 days to manufacture CD103+CD49a+CD39+ NK — is designed on the premise that the CD39+ ISG-high state is an INDUCIBLE endpoint of NK differentiation rather than a fixed pre-existing lineage; every killing/NKG2A result in Figs. 4E, 6E and 7D-F is generated in those induced cells and read back onto primary taNK biology. (2) The NKG2A-blockade rationale ("CD39+ taNK emerge upon anti-NKG2A"), explicitly tied to the monalizumab biosimilar and phase 3 trial NCT05221840 in NSCLC — if CD39+ cells are selected rather than induced, "emergence" is expansion of a fixed pool with a hard ceiling, a different therapeutic prediction. (3) Within this screen (/home/user/aaa/phaseA/claims.json): X4's directionality is inherited from claim D3 ("Human CD56bright NK -> CD56dim NK", itself graded MOSTLY INFERENCE) because GZMK marks CD56bright and GZMB/CD39 the CD56dim-like pole (Bratke 2005, PMID 16106370) — X4 cannot be stronger than D3. It is also the concrete instance backing claims X1 ("organ-resident trNK -> functional intratumoural NK") and X2 ("newly infiltrating NK -> dysfunctional tumour NK"), which assume intratumoural NK states are connected by local differentiation. Rated MEDIUM rather than HIGH because the paper's headline conclusions (CD39 marks the dominant cytotoxic taNK population; NKG2A blockade potentiates it) are cross-sectional/functional and survive intact if the transition is false.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: Claude's initial call — INFERENCE, Serger 2026 snRNA+snATAC trajectory — is CONFIRMED on every element, and the citation is real (PMID 42247486, Sci Immunol 2026;11(120):eaeb6645; preprint 10.1101/2025.08.26.672316), not misremembered. The audit sharpens rather than overturns it, in four ways. (a) Exact class: INF_TRAJECTORY, the weakest class, by rule G2 — MultiVelo velocity + destiny diffusion pseudotime + Monocle3 pseudotime + SCENIC+ regulons ordered along that pseudotime, on one cross-sectional snapshot from 11 pooled donors. (b) The direction is partly ASSUMED, not inferred: both pseudotime methods had their root manually placed inside NK3_GZMK ("the starting point was defined as the terminal branch within the NK3_GZMK population"; "the main root was selected from the NK3_GZMK cluster"), and the trajectory was run only on the NK3 subcompartment, so alternative progenitors (NK1, NK2, ILC1) were excluded by construction. This is weaker than a plain "trajectory inference" label implies. (c) The published version adds evidence Claude's call did not account for — an in vitro platform in which IL-15+TGF-beta(+A549) induces CD103/CD49a and then CD39 on healthy-donor blood NK over 6 days (INF_INVITRO). This is a real conversion demonstration for the PHENOTYPE, but it starts from peripheral blood NK rather than intratumoural GZMK+ NK3, is driven by TGF-beta rather than the ISG/inflammation program the trajectory posits, is scored as bulk population frequencies with no single-cell tracking (IL-15 drives proliferation, so outgrowth of a competent minority is not excluded), and therefore does not raise the claim above INFERENCE. (d) The published version also adds a cross-modality analysis in which the authors themselves conclude the two taNK branches "represent distinct lineages that converge transcriptionally", and they hedge the one time-resolved experiment as "either expands existing... or promotes their induction from CD39- precursors" — so the paper's own text is closer to this audit's grading than its abstract's "revealed an inflammation-driven transition" is. No downgrade below INFERENCE is warranted either: the endpoint state is genuinely tumour-restricted (absent from 50 non-tumour lung donors and from blood), which does argue for local acquisition of the phenotype by SOME NK cell, even though nothing in the paper establishes that the cell in question was GZMK+.
audit.methods_quote: MultiVelo v0.1.5, v2 Methods: "MultiVelo was used to infer velocity trajectory based on both RNA expression and ATAC... The analysis was performed on the NK3 subset pooled across all samples." Root-setting, v1 Methods (moved to supplementary in v2): "To validate the identified transcriptional trajectories and gain deeper insight into the transition from NK3_GZMK to NK3_ENTPD1, we performed pseudotime analysis of these populations using Monocle3 (v1.3.1) on all samples combined. The learn_graph function was run with the parameter 'ncenter = 100' to prevent over-branching of the trajectory. The starting point was defined as the terminal branch within the NK3_GZMK population, based on MultiVelocity and diffusion map analyses." And: "The main root was selected from the NK3_GZMK cluster, at the beginning of the directed streamline inferred by MultiVelocity. Diffusion pseudotime for all cells was then calculated using the DPT function." Sort gate, v1/v2 Methods: "Cells were gated on single cells, live (Zombie NIR-), CD45+, CD19-CD14- and CD56+CD3+." T-cell removal, Methods: "a signature score for T cells (CD3D, CD3G) was calculated using the AddModuleScore_UCell function... Cells with a signature score higher than 0.05 were removed from the dataset in order to obtain a clean NK cell dataset." Author hedge, Results (v1): "Anti-NKG2A therapy either expands existing CD39+GZMA+ and CD39+GZMB+ populations or promotes their induction from CD39- precursors."

EVIDENCE-TYPE JUSTIFICATION. INF_TRAJECTORY (strongest, and the sole basis for the arrow): MultiVelo + destiny + Monocle3 + pseudotime-ordered SCENIC+ regulons. INF_MARKER: the "early" label on NK3_GZMK rests on CD56bright-associated marker genes (CD44, GZMK, KLRF1, CXCR4), and the flow/Xenium work confirms marker co-expression only. INF_INVITRO: the published version's 6-day IL-15+TGF-beta+A549 induction of CD103/CD49a and then CD39 on healthy-donor blood NK — genuine phenotype induction, but from the wrong starting population, via the wrong driver, read as bulk frequencies. INF_KINETIC: listed only because the paper frames the 48 h PDTF anti-NKG2A result as CD39+ taNK "emerging"; the measured quantity is GZMA/GZMB positivity WITHIN CD39+ cells, not a frequency shift of the CD39+ state, and the authors explicitly decline to distinguish expansion from induction — this element carries no lineage weight and should not be counted toward the claim. NO OBS_* class is present: no direct observation, no transfer, no genetic fate map.

TERMINOLOGY DRIFT worth flagging downstream: the middle NK3 subcluster is called NK3_CRTAM in v1 and NK3_CAMK4 in the v2 Fig. 5 legend; and "taNK" in this paper denotes a cytotoxic, prognostically FAVOURABLE population, whereas "TaNK" in Tang et al. Cell 2023 denotes a dysfunctional, prognostically UNFAVOURABLE one. Same acronym, opposite valence.

VERDICT IN ONE LINE: the claim is an analyst-rooted pseudotime/velocity ordering of one cross-sectional 11-donor snapshot, partially supported by an in vitro phenotype induction from a different starting cell — INFERENCE, weakest class, exactly as the initial call had it.
